1	/**
     2	 * Shared normalisation helpers for backend response objects.
     3	 *
     4	 * The Go backend serialises object fields with capitalised keys (`Id`, `Name`,
     5	 * `Url`, etc.). These helpers accept either casing and return a consistently
     6	 * lowercase-keyed object so view code can rely on a single shape.
     7	 *
     8	 * @module utils/normalise
     9	 */
    10	
    11	/**
    12	 * Normalise a repository object from the backend.
    13	 *
    14	 * @param {Object} repo
    15	 * @returns {{ id: string, name: string, url: string }}
    16	 */
    17	export function normaliseRepo(repo) {
    18	    return {
    19	        id:   repo.Id   || repo.id   || '',
    20	        name: repo.Name || repo.name || '',
    21	        url:  repo.Url  || repo.url  || repo.URL || '',
    22	    };
    23	}
    24	
    25	/**
    26	 * Normalise a project object from the backend (Go-style capitalised keys or
    27	 * lowercase — both are supported).
    28	 *
    29	 * @param {Object} project
    30	 * @returns {{ id: string, name: string, description: string, repositories: string[] }}
    31	 */
    32	export function normaliseProject(project) {
    33	    return {
    34	        id:           project.Id          || project.id          || '',
    35	        name:         project.Name        || project.name        || '',
    36	        description:  project.Description || project.description || '',
    37	        repositories: Array.isArray(project.Repositories)
    38	            ? project.Repositories
    39	            : (Array.isArray(project.repositories) ? project.repositories : []),
    40	    };
    41	}
    42	
    43	/**
    44	 * Normalise a workspace object from the backend.
    45	 *
    46	 * The backend returns `WorkspaceID` and `DateCreated` (not `Id` / `CreatedAt`),
    47	 * so we must map both naming conventions.
    48	 *
    49	 * @param {Object} ws
    50	 * @returns {{ id: string, description: string, createdAt: string, initialized: boolean }}
    51	 */
    52	export function normaliseWorkspace(ws) {
    53	    return {
    54	        id:          ws.WorkspaceID || ws.Id   || ws.id          || '',
    55	        description: ws.Description || ws.description || '',
    56	        createdAt:   ws.DateCreated || ws.CreatedAt || ws.createdAt || ws.created_at || '',
    57	        initialized: ws.Initialized != null ? ws.Initialized : (ws.initialized != null ? ws.initialized : true),
    58	        folderPath:  ws.FolderPath  || ws.folderPath  || '',
    59	    };
    60	}
    61	
    62	/**
    63	 * Normalise an error log entry from the backend.
    64	 *
    65	 * The Go backend serialises struct fields with capitalised keys (`Id`,
    66	 * `Severity`, `Source`, `Message`, `Details`, `Timestamp`, `Project`,
    67	 * `Workspace`, `Repository`). This helper accepts either casing and returns
    68	 * a consistently camelCase-keyed object for use in view code.
    69	 *
    70	 * @param {Object} entry
    71	 * @returns {{
    72	 *   id:         number,
    73	 *   severity:   string,
    74	 *   source:     string,
    75	 *   message:    string,
    76	 *   details:    string,
    77	 *   timestamp:  string,
    78	 *   project:    string,
    79	 *   workspace:  string,
    80	 *   repository: string
    81	 * }}
    82	 */
    83	export function normaliseErrorEntry(entry) {
    84	    return {
    85	        id:         entry.Id         ?? entry.id         ?? 0,
    86	        severity:   entry.Severity   || entry.severity   || '',
    87	        source:     entry.Source     || entry.source     || '',
    88	        message:    entry.Message    || entry.message    || '',
    89	        details:    entry.Details    || entry.details    || '',
    90	        timestamp:  entry.Timestamp  || entry.timestamp  || '',
    91	        project:    entry.Project    || entry.project    || '',
    92	        workspace:  entry.Workspace  || entry.workspace  || '',
    93	        repository: entry.Repository || entry.repository || '',
    94	    };
    95	}

1	/**
     2	 * Repo Status Cells Component — Repo Parallelizer GUI.
     3	 *
     4	 * Encapsulates the reusable Branch, Status badge, and Actions `<td>` cell-building
     5	 * logic shared between the workspace-detail and repository-detail views.
     6	 *
     7	 * ## Exported functions
     8	 *
     9	 * - `buildRepoStatusCells`   — Build the three `<td>` elements for a single
    10	 *   repository row (branch, badge, actions). Callers assemble the full `<tr>`.
    11	 * - `makeBranchTrigger`      — Build a `<button class="branch-switch-trigger">`.
    12	 * - `updateRepoStatusCells`  — Update branch and badge cells in-place within a
    13	 *   `<tr>`, locating them by CSS class (`.repo-branch-cell`,
    14	 *   `div[data-repo-id]`) rather than by hardcoded cell indices. The
    15	 *   branch-trigger aria-label is sourced from `row.dataset.repoName`
    16	 *   when present, falling back to `repoId` when the attribute is absent.
    17	 *
    18	 * @module repo-status-cells
    19	 */
    20	
    21	import { api }               from '../api.js';
    22	import { createStatusBadge } from './status-badge.js';
    23	
    24	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    25	// Public exports
    26	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    27	
    28	/**
    29	 * Build a branch-switch trigger `<button>` styled as inline text.
    30	 *
    31	 * Extracted to avoid duplicating the element setup in both `buildRepoStatusCells`
    32	 * (initial render) and `updateRepoStatusCells` (polling updates). The click
    33	 * handler is wired by the caller so it can close over a fresh `trigger`
    34	 * reference.
    35	 *
    36	 * @param {string} branchName - Branch name shown as the button label.
    37	 * @param {string} ariaLabel  - Accessible label for screen-readers.
    38	 * @returns {HTMLButtonElement}
    39	 */
    40	export function makeBranchTrigger(branchName, ariaLabel) {
    41	    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    42	    btn.type        = 'button';
    43	    btn.className   = 'branch-switch-trigger';
    44	    btn.textContent = branchName;
    45	    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', ariaLabel);
    46	    return btn;
    47	}
    48	
    49	/**
    50	 * Build the three shared status `<td>` cells for a single repository row.
    51	 *
    52	 * Returns a plain object with `branchCell`, `badgeCell`, and `actionsCell`
    53	 * so the caller can insert them into whatever `<tr>` it is constructing,
    54	 * interleaving its own cells (e.g. a repository name cell) as needed.
    55	 *
    56	 * @param {Object} opts
    57	 * @param {string}      opts.repoId      - Unique repository identifier.
    58	 * @param {string}      opts.repoName    - Human-readable display name; used in
    59	 *                                         aria-labels. Falls back to `repoId` when
    60	 *                                         the caller has no richer name.
